extract: The Eye is a raid set in Tempest Keep in the Netherstorm. It is the fortress' inner sanctum and the stronghold of the "Sun King", Kael'thas Sunstrider. In-game and out of it, the raid is often simply called "Tempest Keep", even though this more accurately refers to the entire instance complex that includes both this raid and the three dungeons Arcatraz, Botanica, and Mechanar. The tokens for tier 5 shoulder and chest pieces drop in the Eye. There is no longer any attunement required to enter this instance.
